blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) donated medicines to Barangay Nancamarinan, Paniqui, Tarlac, during a turnover ceremony held on October 8, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office. The turnover ceremony was facilitated by Ruby Octava, Nurse III of the PCSO Medical Services Department (MSD), who formally handed over the medicines under the agency’s Medicine Donation Program. Alvin Mainot received the donation on behalf of Barangay Nancamarinan. The donation aims to supplement the barangay’s medical resources and strengthen its capacity to address the healthcare needs of residents, particularly those with limited access to essential medicines.
